title: Kissinger involved in UFO matters

tellings.quote: >> And I've uncovered a lot around Kissinger actually being involved in the UFO stuff.

plain: Henry Kissinger, the former US Secretary of State, was involved in the government's handling of UFOs, Michels says. He tells this himself, in a conversation with the comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan, saying he has uncovered a lot about it, but he gives no source or details. If true, it would put UFO secrecy in the hands of the most senior figures in American foreign policy.
